logos.placement: white shelf inside the safe area

copy.voice: Clear, confident, welcoming and practical. Invite participation without hype.
copy.facts: Preserve dates, time zones, venues, proper names and real URLs. Invent no facts, speakers, price, deadline or registration link.
copy.localization: One complete visual and caption per selected language. Translate naturally, respect supplied translations, and preserve exact event facts.
copy.cta: Use one clear next step. Keep CTA text at most 40 characters.

caption.direction: Open with a benefit or question. Use short paragraphs, event details, one CTA and 1–3 relevant hashtags.
Use a very short event message and one CTA. No hashtag block. A native link sticker is added manually during publication.
Write a welcoming community announcement: who it is for, value, practical details and one direct next step. Use complete sentences and no hashtag block.
Write a concise team announcement with an optional *bold* title, essential details and one event link. No hashtag block.

implementation.visuals: AI designs the full canvas from shared campaign identity, desired style, palette and references. No fixed layout, font rules, safe-area grid, border or local logo overlay. The optional offline template renderer retains its separate layout.
implementation.paletteOverrides: Project palette overrides the default three colors. Adjust text tones to maintain contrast; preserve original logo colors.
implementation.longText: Caption ranges are editorial writing guidance, not validation limits. Preserve facts and full URLs; never block visual generation or approval because of caption length.
